items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Yeah, that’s a nice hall. I like that. Really well designed.

I’ve got a recording that you recorded there. But we’ll get back to that. Next, Slewfoot with Norman Connors. So he had already done his other major all-star session. Here’s the second one – another – probably the third one. Some of the same folks. I’m not sure if this was – this was recorded in July ’74, New York, Eddie Henderson, yourself, Gary Bartz, Lonnie Liston Smith, Dom Um Romao on percussion
